steps.en: Officer selects notices in the search results
steps.id: Officer memilih notice di hasil pencarian

steps.en: Officer selects notices in the uploaded list
steps.id: Officer memilih notice di daftar hasil upload

steps.en: Officer chooses the TS operation and presses Select
steps.id: Officer memilih operasi TS lalu menekan Select

steps.en: Selected notices are checked for TS eligibility
steps.id: Notice terpilih dicek apakah boleh di-TS
steps.why_en: One ineligible notice blocks the whole selection, and a failed check shows no message.
steps.why_id: Satu notice yang tidak boleh di-TS memblokir seluruh pilihan, dan pengecekan yang gagal tidak menampilkan pesan.

steps.en: Selected notices move on to the TS page
steps.id: Notice terpilih dibawa ke halaman TS
